about_the_game:
Clicker Astro Planet is a cosmic economic clicker game where you will build your own galactic empire. Expand production, automate processes, and manage resources, turning a single click into a powerful futuristic industry.

Start with just one click and earn Cosmo-Credits — the main currency of the game. Every upgrade boosts your growth, multiplying production by tens, hundreds, or even thousands. Develop your business, automate resource extraction, unlock new technologies, and transform planets into centers of interstellar economy.

Key Features:

Advanced click system
Each click generates Cosmo-Credits. Upgrade your clicks to earn more with every tap.

X2 Boost
Activate a temporary income multiplier. Double your profits in seconds — and do it again and again.

Bonus button
Occasionally, a bonus appears on screen — tap it to instantly gain extra Cosmo-Credits.

Powerful upgrades
Unlock upgrades for clicks, automation, bonuses, and strategic enhancements to accelerate your progress.

Three types of autoclickers

  • Pulsing: generate income at regular intervals.

  • Timed: provide a short but massive production boost.

  • Production-based: extract rare Cosmo-Gold, needed for elite improvements.

Planet overheating mechanic
Intense activity raises your planet’s temperature. Monitor the heat, adjust your strategy, and maintain balance.

Planet acquisition
Buy and conquer new planets, each with unique traits and resources. Every new world is a step forward in your galactic expansion.

Research system
Develop science and unlock new technologies that boost income, automation, and efficiency.

Mini-games
Enjoy dynamic mini-games like the "Destroyer" mode, where you break asteroids to collect rare resources and speed up progress.

Resource extraction
Unlock and upgrade generators, mine Cosmo-Credits, gold, and other valuable materials essential for development.

Global upgrades
Unlock permanent bonuses that enhance all current and future production units.

Idle mode
Your empire keeps working even when you're away — earn income in the background and come back stronger.

Customization and empire naming
Give your galactic empire a unique name and customize key elements. Build a world that reflects your vision.

Why try Clicker Astro Planet:

  • Deep progression, upgrade, and automation systems

  • Multiple types of autoclickers with unique mechanics

  • Planet overheating that impacts strategy and pacing

  • Unlockable planets to grow your empire

  • Engaging mini-games for active gameplay moments

  • Research mechanics for long-term advancement

  • Personalization options and custom empire naming

  • Constant growth and idle profit, even when offline

  • Graphics: Any with DirectX 9.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
